sourceCitations.fact: KeyedWork logs start, sleeps 40 ms, calls guarded commit, then logs commit result.
same-id test flushes twice, calls settle, then asserts results.
settle is three Task.yield calls plus 120 ms sleep.
Node alive/generation/task state is mutable; generation guards stale work.
TaskOwnerToken commit rejects when handle is nil or node is dead/generation differs.
teardown marks node dead, increments generation, and cancels task.
startTask cancels prior task, increments generation, and installs TaskLocal token.
same task id does not restart; changed id restarts.
commit always advances layout, collects changes, resolves, and emits.
